evidence.test_run: 20 tests pass in tests/test_execution_state.py covering state creation, node output save/get, context passing, lifecycle transitions, resume point tracking, graceful degradation without repo
evidence.e2e: Backend: execution_state.py (service), workflow_repository.py (execution_states table + CRUD), job_executor.py (integrated checkpointing + resume), execution_states.py (REST API: GET state, GET nodes, GET context, POST resume). Frontend: useExecutionState.ts (composable), StateViewer.vue (UI panel with node outputs, context, info tabs, resume dialog). Cleanup integrated into job_persistence scheduler.

features.notes: Full stateful execution system: PostgreSQL execution_states table with JSONB node_states and context. Per-node checkpointing after each successful execution. Resume from checkpoint via POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/resume (copies completed state to new job). State Viewer UI with tabs for node outputs, shared context, and metadata. Configurable retention (default 72h) with auto-cleanup.

evidence.e2e: Backend: workflow_repository.py (uploads table + jobs.minio_path + jobs.result_minio_path columns, CRUD methods), journey_jobs.py (DB-first submit: writes PostgreSQL immediately + uploads MinIO + creates upload record, list_jobs queries DB first with RAM fallback), uploads.py (REST API: list/get/download uploads, get uploads per job). Export workflow A → Import into new account → verify identical structure
Frontend: click Export → file downloads, click Import → file picker opens
Test URL import: provide hosted JSON URL → workflow imported
features.notes: Enables workflow sharing between teams/projects. Export format is a superset of the canvas DSL with added metadata (version, author, created_at). Import validates schema compatibility before creating.

features.description: Document Comparison — Compare 2 documents side-by-side, highlight textual differences and structural changes
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /api/v1/compare accepts 2 files, returns diff analysis
Text diff: word-level comparison with additions/deletions/changes highlighted
Structure diff: layout changes (moved sections, new tables, removed figures)
Similarity score: overall percentage match between documents
Visual diff: generate annotated images showing differences
Support: PDF vs PDF, Image vs Image, mixed formats
Frontend: side-by-side viewer with highlighted diff regions
test_steps: POST /api/v1/compare with 2 identical files → verify 100% match
POST /api/v1/compare with 2 different files → verify diff output
Verify diff contains: additions, deletions, modifications with positions
Test similarity_score: 0.0 (completely different) to 1.0 (identical)
Test mixed format: compare PDF vs image version of same doc
Frontend: upload 2 files → see side-by-side with highlights
features.notes: Useful for contract version comparison, form validation, document authenticity checking. Uses OCR + layout recognition on both docs, then runs diff algorithm on extracted text and structure.
